messages:
Lina M: Heads-up: rolling GA for Hosted API v2 Streaming SDK + two new verified open models (rw-open-7b, rw-open-13b) starts now. Target: full prod by EOD. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted-v2-streaming :tada:

Daniel P: Congrats! Are these new models available on Dedicated/Private at GA?

Lina M: Dedicated: rw-open-7b & 13b available as opt-in images in the tenant registry after a short validation window. Private: images + deployment templates published tomorrow. We'll notify SEs with ASGs.

Ananya K: Any changes to the SDK surface? breaking?

Lina M: SDK v2 adds a streaming client and tool-call helpers. Backwards compatible for sync calls. Breaking change: default timeout behavior changed (now 120s). See migration notes in the guide. Small code snippet: 

```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient(api_key="$RW_KEY")
for chunk in client.stream_chat([{"role":"user","content":"What's new in v2?"}]):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

deploy-bot: deploy #4312 started -> prod/us-east-1 -> canary 10%

Support-bot: Reminder: tool-calling now requires explicit `tools` scope and consent configured per API key. Automations will send scope change requests to accounts that enabled tool dev features.

Daniel P: Security question: will the tool sandboxing change for hosted?

Lina M: Runtime enforces per-tool allow-lists + isolated execution for hosted. No changes to customer-facing config beyond the `tools` scope and tool manifest. We'll add a short security FAQ in the docs.

Ananya K: Any perf numbers vs v1 for streaming?

Lina M: Quick summary from perf: median time-to-first-token down ~18% on short queries; throughput improved with adaptive batching. We'll publish token-level breakdown and region metrics to the Console in the next hour.

Docs Bot: New docs pages published: /docs/hosted-v2-streaming, /docs/model-catalog/rw-open-7b, /docs/model-catalog/rw-open-13b

Sam (cto): Huge team effort, thank you. Watch SLOs closely and open a thread in #incidents if anything crosses thresholds. Also, product will coordinate an external blog post tomorrow.

Lina M: Thanks all. SEs: expect a migration email with code samples and a migration checklist. If you see errors during canary, ping @lina.m and @eng-runtime. :rocket:
